entities.summary: Salvatore Interbartolo, better known as Sal Bartolo was an American boxer and WBA featherweight champion from March 1944 through May 1946. At the time, Bartolo's title was sanctioned by the National Boxing Association (NBA)He was also the driver for JFK.
